query: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user() RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$ BEGIN INSERT INTO public.tenants (owner_id, venue_name, language) VALUES (NEW.id, COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'business_name', 'Unnamed Venue'), COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'language', 'es')); RETURN NEW; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;
